description:
Services currently in a given state. Pass state="critical" for the usual "what is broken" question.

Before reporting an entry as a new incident, check list_service_acknowledgements and
list_service_downtimes: a problem already acknowledged or inside a downtime window is
known work.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 500.

state.description: Service state to filter by. Required.

name: list_services_by_state

outputSchema.description: Rows plus enough context to know whether they are all of them.

hint.description: How to narrow the query when truncated.

items.description: The rows, at most `limit` of them.

truncated.description: True if openITCOCKPIT held more rows than were returned.

title: Services by State
